content.caption: Green checkmark icon used in the WikiSkill ablation table (Table 3) to indicate that wiki access is enabled for a component.
content.description: The picture is a small, bold green checkmark (tick) on a plain white background. It has a short stroke descending to the bottom and a longer stroke rising to the upper right. It contains no text, numbers, or other elements. On the page, this icon appears in Table 3, the ablation study of WikiSkill using Gemini-3.5-Flash. There it means 'yes, has wiki access' in the 'Inference Agent Wiki Access' and 'Skill Proposer Wiki Access' columns. A red cross means no access. In the table, green checks appear in three places: (1) the Inference Agent column of the configuration where only the Inference Agent has wiki access (average 45.3); (2) both columns of the configuration where both components have wiki access (average 60.9); and (3) the Skill Proposer column of the default WikiSkill configuration, where only the Skill Proposer has wiki access (average 63.7).
